---
title: "methylarray analysis report"
format:
  html:
    embed-resources: true
    toc: true
    toc-depth: 2
    # Contents on the left, the rest of the page for the report itself
    toc-location: left
    toc-title: Contents
    page-layout: full
    theme: cosmo
    include-in-header:
      text: |
        <style>
        /* Wide tables scroll inside the text column */
        main.content table { display: block; max-width: 100%; overflow-x: auto; }
        main.content table caption { white-space: normal; }
        /* Every table is a toggle with its bold name; closed until clicked */
        details.report-table { margin: 0.7rem 0; border: 1px solid #dee2e6; border-radius: 4px; padding: 0.35rem 0.75rem; }
        details.report-table > summary { cursor: pointer; }
        details.report-table[open] > summary { margin-bottom: 0.5rem; }
        /* Figures fill the column up to their natural size */
        main.content img.report-figure { display: block; width: 100%; height: auto; }
        /* Long commands wrap instead of running off the page */
        main.content pre, main.content pre code { white-space: pre-wrap; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
        /* Search box above the contents */
        .report-search { margin: 0 0 1rem 0; }
        .report-search input { width: 100%; padding: 0.3rem 0.5rem; border: 1px solid #ced4da; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 0.9rem; }
        .report-search-bar { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.3rem; margin-top: 0.3rem; font-size: 0.8rem; color: #555; }
        .report-search-bar button { border: 1px solid #ced4da; background: #f8f9fa; border-radius: 3px; padding: 0 0.45rem; line-height: 1.4; }
        mark.report-hit { background: #ffe58a; padding: 0; }
        mark.report-hit.report-hit-current { background: #ff9f43; }
        </style>
    include-after-body:
      text: |
        <script>
        // Search the whole report: every match is highlighted, Enter or the arrows
        // jump between matches, and a closed table opens when a match is inside it
        (function () {
          function ready(f) { if (document.readyState !== "loading") f(); else document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", f); }
          ready(function () {
            var main = document.querySelector("main.content") || document.body;
            var toc = document.getElementById("TOC");
            var box = document.createElement("div");
            box.className = "report-search";
            box.innerHTML = '<input type="search" placeholder="Search the report" aria-label="Search the report">' +
              '<div class="report-search-bar"><button type="button" data-step="-1" aria-label="Previous match">&#8593;</button>' +
              '<button type="button" data-step="1" aria-label="Next match">&#8595;</button><span class="report-search-count"></span></div>';
            if (toc && toc.parentNode) toc.parentNode.insertBefore(box, toc); else main.insertBefore(box, main.firstChild);
            var input = box.querySelector("input"), count = box.querySelector(".report-search-count");
            var hits = [], current = -1, timer = null;
            function clear() {
              main.querySelectorAll("mark.report-hit").forEach(function (m) {
                var parent = m.parentNode;
                parent.replaceChild(document.createTextNode(m.textContent), m);
                parent.normalize();
              });
              hits = []; current = -1;
            }
            function go(step) {
              if (!hits.length) return;
              if (current >= 0) hits[current].classList.remove("report-hit-current");
              current = (current + step + hits.length) % hits.length;
              var hit = hits[current];
              for (var d = hit.closest("details"); d; d = d.parentElement ? d.parentElement.closest("details") : null) d.open = true;
              hit.classList.add("report-hit-current");
              hit.scrollIntoView({ block: "center" });
              count.textContent = (current + 1) + " of " + hits.length;
            }
            function search(term) {
              clear();
              if (term.length < 2) { count.textContent = ""; return; }
              var lower = term.toLowerCase(), nodes = [];
              var walker = document.createTreeWalker(main, NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT);
              while (walker.nextNode()) {
                var node = walker.currentNode;
                if (node.nodeValue.toLowerCase().indexOf(lower) < 0) continue;
                if (node.parentElement.closest("script, style, .report-search")) continue;
                nodes.push(node);
              }
              nodes.forEach(function (node) {
                var text = node.nodeValue, low = text.toLowerCase(), frag = document.createDocumentFragment(), i = 0, j;
                while ((j = low.indexOf(lower, i)) >= 0) {
                  frag.appendChild(document.createTextNode(text.slice(i, j)));
                  var m = document.createElement("mark");
                  m.className = "report-hit";
                  m.textContent = text.slice(j, j + term.length);
                  frag.appendChild(m);
                  hits.push(m);
                  i = j + term.length;
                }
                frag.appendChild(document.createTextNode(text.slice(i)));
                node.parentNode.replaceChild(frag, node);
              });
              count.textContent = hits.length ? hits.length + " matches" : "No matches";
              if (hits.length) go(1);
            }
            input.addEventListener("input", function () { clearTimeout(timer); timer = setTimeout(function () { search(input.value.trim()); }, 250); });
            input.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) { if (e.key === "Enter") { e.preventDefault(); go(e.shiftKey ? -1 : 1); } });
            box.querySelectorAll("button").forEach(function (b) { b.addEventListener("click", function () { go(parseInt(b.getAttribute("data-step"), 10)); }); });
          });
        })();
        </script>
    fig-width: 8
    fig-height: 4.5
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

```{r setup}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
    library(data.table)
    library(ggplot2)
    library(jsonlite)
    library(knitr)
})
inputs <- "inputs"
find <- function(pattern) sort(list.files(inputs, pattern = pattern, full.names = TRUE))
has <- function(pattern) length(find(pattern)) > 0
read <- function(file) {
    if (!endsWith(file, ".gz")) return(fread(file, na.strings = c("", "NA")))
    if (file.info(file)[["size"]] < 100) return(fread(text = readLines(gzfile(file)), na.strings = c("", "NA")))
    fread(cmd = paste("gzip -dc", shQuote(file)), na.strings = c("", "NA"))
}
model_of <- function(file, prefix, suffix) sub(paste0("^", prefix), "", sub(paste0(suffix, "$"), "", basename(file)))
# Publication theme: white background, light major grid, readable text
theme_set(theme_bw(base_size = 11) + theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95", colour = "grey70"),
                                         legend.key = element_blank(), plot.title.position = "plot"))
options(knitr.kable.NA = "")
params_run <- if (has("^params\\.json$")) fromJSON(find("^params\\.json$")) else list()
param <- function(name) { v <- params_run[[name]]; if (is.null(v)) "" else as.character(v) }
heading <- function(text) cat("\n\n#", text, "\n\n")
# knitr::kable rounds every number to 7 decimals, which prints small P-values
# as 0: format numbers to 4 significant digits instead (scientific below 0.001)
format_number <- function(v) vapply(v, function(z) {
    if (is.na(z)) return(NA_character_)
    if (is.finite(z) && z == round(z) && abs(z) < 1e15) return(format(z, scientific = FALSE, trim = TRUE))
    if (is.finite(z) && z != 0 && abs(z) < 1e-3) return(formatC(z, digits = 2, format = "e"))
    format(signif(z, 4), scientific = FALSE, trim = TRUE, drop0trailing = TRUE)
}, character(1))
# Every table is a numbered toggle: its bold name is shown, the whole table
# opens on a click
table_number <- 0
kable <- function(x, ..., caption = "Table", align = NULL) {
    x <- as.data.frame(x, check.names = FALSE)
    numeric_columns <- vapply(x, is.numeric, logical(1))
    for (j in which(vapply(x, is.double, logical(1)))) x[[j]] <- format_number(x[[j]])
    table <- knitr::kable(x, format = "pipe", ..., align = if (is.null(align)) ifelse(numeric_columns, "r", "l") else align)
    table_number <<- table_number + 1
    name <- htmltools::htmlEscape(sub("[.]$", "", caption))
    structure(paste0("\n\n<details class=\"report-table\">\n<summary><strong>Table ", table_number, ". ", name, "</strong> (",
                              nrow(x), if (nrow(x) == 1) " row" else " rows", ")</summary>\n\n", paste(table, collapse = "\n"), "\n\n</details>\n\n"), class = c("report_table", "knit_asis"))
}
# print() of a table inside a loop writes it as it is, like a table at the top level
print.report_table <- function(x, ...) cat(x)
# Every figure: saved as a 300 dpi PNG and a vector PDF in figures/ (for
# papers) and shown sharp at any zoom: as a vector SVG, or as the 300 dpi PNG
# when it has so many points that an SVG would be slow, with a numbered
# caption below it. The plot's title and subtitle become the caption and are
# left out of the image.
dir.create("figures", showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create("report_figures", showWarnings = FALSE)
figure_number <- 0
slug <- function(text) substr(gsub("(^_|_$)", "", gsub("[^a-z0-9]+", "_", tolower(text))), 1, 60)
plot_rows <- function(plot) {
    rows <- if (is.data.frame(plot[["data"]])) nrow(plot[["data"]]) else 0
    for (layer in plot[["layers"]]) if (is.data.frame(layer[["data"]])) rows <- rows + nrow(layer[["data"]])
    rows
}
show_plot <- function(plot, width = NULL, height = NULL, description = NULL) {
    width <- if (is.null(width)) knitr::opts_current$get("fig.width") else width
    height <- if (is.null(height)) knitr::opts_current$get("fig.height") else height
    # ggsave refuses figures above 50 inches: cap the size instead of stopping the report
    width <- min(width, 49)
    height <- min(height, 49)
    figure_number <<- figure_number + 1
    title <- plot[["labels"]][["title"]]
    subtitle <- plot[["labels"]][["subtitle"]]
    caption <- paste(c(if (!is.null(title)) paste0(sub("[.]$", "", title), "."), subtitle, description), collapse = " ")
    plot <- plot + labs(title = NULL, subtitle = NULL)
    name <- sprintf("figure_%02d_%s", figure_number, slug(if (is.null(title)) "figure" else title))
    png_file <- file.path("figures", paste0(name, ".png"))
    ggsave(png_file, plot, width = width, height = height, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
    ggsave(file.path("figures", paste0(name, ".pdf")), plot, width = width, height = height, bg = "white")
    shown <- png_file
    if (plot_rows(plot) <= 5000) {
        shown <- file.path("report_figures", paste0(name, ".svg"))
        grDevices::svg(shown, width = width, height = height, bg = "white")
        print(plot)
        grDevices::dev.off()
    }
    cat("\n\n![**Figure ", figure_number, ".** ", gsub("\n", " ", caption), "](", shown, "){.report-figure style=\"max-width: ",
        round(120 * width), "px\"}\n\n", sep = "")
}
# Directional Manhattan plots (as in Uddin et al. 2022, Fig. 1a): -log10 P
# times the sign of the effect, so CpGs with higher methylation point up and
# those with lower methylation point down. Every CpG with P < 0.01 is drawn, and
# every 20th of the others; CpGs at FDR < 0.05 are coloured by direction.
chromosome_levels <- c(1:22, "X", "Y")
manhattan_points <- function(d, effect) {
    d <- d[!is.na(chr) & !is.na(pos) & !is.na(p_value) & !is.na(get(effect))]
    d[, chromosome := factor(sub("^chr", "", chr), levels = chromosome_levels)]
    d <- d[!is.na(chromosome) & (p_value < 0.01 | seq_len(.N) %% 20 == 0)]
    d[, signed := sign(get(effect)) * -log10(pmax(p_value, 1e-300))]
    d[, direction := ifelse(get(effect) > 0, "higher", "lower")]
    d
}
threshold_lines <- function(d) {
    lines <- data.table(y = -log10(as.numeric(param("p_epigenome_wide"))), line = paste0("P = ", param("p_epigenome_wide"), " (epigenome-wide)"))
    if ("fdr" %in% names(d) && any(d[["fdr"]] < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)) lines <- rbind(lines, data.table(y = -log10(max(d[fdr < 0.05, p_value])), line = "FDR = 0.05"))
    lines <- lines[is.finite(y)]
    rbind(lines, copy(lines)[, y := -y])
}
direction_colours <- c(higher = "#c44e52", lower = "#4c72b0")
manhattan_colours <- c(`FDR < 0.05, higher` = "#b2182b", `FDR < 0.05, lower` = "#2166ac", `not significant, odd chromosome` = "grey35",
                       `not significant, even chromosome` = "grey70")
directional_genome <- function(d, lines, title) {
    ends <- d[, .(end = max(pos)), by = chromosome][order(chromosome)]
    ends[, offset := c(0, head(cumsum(as.numeric(end) + 5e6), -1))]
    d <- merge(d, ends[, .(chromosome, offset)], by = "chromosome")
    d[, x := (pos + offset) / 1e6]
    significant <- if ("fdr" %in% names(d)) !is.na(d[["fdr"]]) & d[["fdr"]] < 0.05 else rep(FALSE, nrow(d))
    d[, class := ifelse(significant, paste0("FDR < 0.05, ", direction),
                        ifelse(as.integer(chromosome) %% 2 == 1, "not significant, odd chromosome", "not significant, even chromosome"))]
    d[, class := factor(class, levels = names(manhattan_colours))]
    setorder(d, class)
    d <- d[order(-as.integer(class))]
    centres <- d[, .(x = mean(range(x))), by = chromosome]
    ggplot(d, aes(x, signed, colour = class)) + geom_point(size = 0.7, show.legend = c(colour = TRUE, linetype = FALSE)) +
        geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey20", linewidth = 0.3) +
        geom_hline(data = lines, aes(yintercept = y, linetype = line), colour = "grey20", linewidth = 0.4, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
        scale_colour_manual(values = manhattan_colours, breaks = c("FDR < 0.05, higher", "FDR < 0.05, lower"),
                            labels = c("Higher methylation (FDR < 0.05)", "Lower methylation (FDR < 0.05)"), drop = FALSE) +
        scale_linetype_manual(values = setNames(c(1, 2), c(paste0("P = ", param("p_epigenome_wide"), " (epigenome-wide)"), "FDR = 0.05"))) +
        scale_x_continuous(breaks = centres[["x"]], labels = as.character(centres[["chromosome"]]), expand = expansion(mult = 0.01)) +
        scale_y_continuous(labels = function(y) format(abs(y)), expand = expansion(mult = 0.05)) +
        guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 2.5))) +
        theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(), axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8), legend.position = "bottom", legend.box = "vertical") +
        labs(x = "Chromosome", y = expression(-log[10](italic(P)) ~ "(up: higher, down: lower)"), colour = NULL, linetype = NULL, title = title,
             subtitle = "Directional Manhattan plot: each point is a CpG at its genomic position; the height is -log10 P, drawn upwards for higher and downwards for lower methylation. Grey points alternate by chromosome; CpGs with P >= 0.01 are thinned to every 20th.")
}
# Top CpGs with higher and with lower methylation, as two tables
top_by_direction <- function(d, effect, columns, caption, n = 20) {
    for (direction in c("higher", "lower")) {
        part <- if (direction == "higher") d[get(effect) > 0] else d[get(effect) < 0]
        part <- head(part[order(p_value)], n)
        if (nrow(part) == 0) next
        print(kable(part[, columns, with = FALSE], col.names = names(columns),
                    caption = paste0(caption, ": the ", nrow(part), " CpGs with ", direction, " methylation and the smallest P")))
    }
}
# Interpretation of association results (todo section 2e: I1, I3, I4, I5),
# after Uddin et al. 2022 and Kirmani et al. 2025
significant_direction <- function(d, effect) {
    ifelse(!is.na(d[["fdr"]]) & d[["fdr"]] < 0.05, ifelse(d[[effect]] > 0, "higher", "lower"), "not significant")
}
volcano_plot <- function(d, effect, effect_label, title) {
    d <- d[!is.na(p_value) & !is.na(get(effect))]
    d[, class := factor(significant_direction(d, effect), levels = c("higher", "lower", "not significant"))]
    d <- d[class != "not significant" | p_value < 0.01 | seq_len(.N) %% 10 == 0][order(-as.integer(class))]
    lines <- data.table(y = -log10(as.numeric(param("p_epigenome_wide"))), line = paste0("P = ", param("p_epigenome_wide"), " (epigenome-wide)"))
    if (any(d[["class"]] != "not significant")) lines <- rbind(lines, data.table(y = -log10(max(d[class != "not significant", p_value])), line = "FDR = 0.05"))
    ggplot(d, aes(get(effect), -log10(pmax(p_value, 1e-300)), colour = class)) + geom_point(size = 0.7, show.legend = c(colour = TRUE, linetype = FALSE)) +
        geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.3) +
        geom_hline(data = lines, aes(yintercept = y, linetype = line), colour = "grey20", linewidth = 0.4, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
        scale_colour_manual(values = c(higher = "#b2182b", lower = "#2166ac", `not significant` = "grey70"), drop = FALSE,
                            labels = c(higher = "Higher methylation (FDR < 0.05)", lower = "Lower methylation (FDR < 0.05)", `not significant` = "Not significant")) +
        scale_linetype_manual(values = setNames(c(1, 2), c(paste0("P = ", param("p_epigenome_wide"), " (epigenome-wide)"), "FDR = 0.05"))) +
        guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 2.5))) +
        theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.box = "vertical") +
        labs(x = effect_label, y = expression(-log[10](italic(P))), colour = NULL, linetype = NULL, title = title,
             subtitle = "Volcano plot: effect size against significance for every CpG; CpGs with P >= 0.01 that are not significant are thinned to every 10th.")
}
# I3: hits by direction, with a binomial test of the balance
direction_summary <- function(d, effect) {
    hits <- !is.na(d[["fdr"]]) & d[["fdr"]] < 0.05
    higher <- sum(hits & d[[effect]] > 0, na.rm = TRUE)
    lower <- sum(hits & d[[effect]] < 0, na.rm = TRUE)
    data.table(`CpGs tested` = nrow(d), `Hits (FDR < 0.05)` = higher + lower,
               Higher = higher, `Higher (% of tested)` = round(100 * higher / nrow(d), 3),
               Lower = lower, `Lower (% of tested)` = round(100 * lower / nrow(d), 3),
               `Share higher` = if (higher + lower > 0) round(higher / (higher + lower), 3) else NA_real_,
               `Binomial P (balance)` = if (higher + lower > 0) binom.test(higher, higher + lower)[["p.value"]] else NA_real_)
}
# I4: genomic context of the hits by direction, against all tested CpGs
context_categories <- function(d) {
    cgi <- d[["cgi_relation"]]
    cgi[is.na(cgi)] <- ""
    feature <- d[["gene_group"]]
    feature[is.na(feature)] <- ""
    gene <- d[["gene"]]
    gene[is.na(gene)] <- ""
    list(
        `CpG island context` = list(
            Island = grepl("Island", cgi), Shore = grepl("Shore", cgi), Shelf = grepl("Shelf", cgi), `Open sea` = cgi == ""),
        `Gene feature` = list(
            TSS1500 = grepl("TSS1500", feature), TSS200 = grepl("TSS200", feature), `5'UTR` = grepl("5UTR", feature),
            `First exon` = grepl("exon_1(;|$)", feature), `Other exons` = grepl("exon_([2-9]|[1-9][0-9]+)(;|$)", feature),
            `3'UTR` = grepl("3UTR", feature), `Intron or other gene part` = feature == "" & gene != "", Intergenic = feature == "" & gene == "")
    )
}
context_enrichment <- function(d, effect) {
    if (!all(c("cgi_relation", "gene_group", "gene") %in% names(d))) return(data.table())
    direction <- significant_direction(d, effect)
    categories <- context_categories(d)
    rbindlist(lapply(c("all hits", "higher", "lower"), function(query_name) {
        query <- if (query_name == "all hits") direction != "not significant" else direction == query_name
        if (sum(query) < 5) return(NULL)
        rbindlist(lapply(names(categories), function(group) rbindlist(lapply(names(categories[[group]]), function(category) {
            member <- categories[[group]][[category]]
            test <- fisher.test(matrix(c(sum(query & member), sum(query & !member), sum(!query & member), sum(!query & !member)), 2))
            data.table(group = group, category = category, query = query_name, hits_in = sum(query & member), hits = sum(query),
                       share_hits = sum(query & member) / sum(query), share_tested = mean(member),
                       odds_ratio = unname(test[["estimate"]]), ci_low = test[["conf.int"]][1], ci_high = test[["conf.int"]][2], p_value = test[["p.value"]])
        }))))
    }))
}
context_plot <- function(table, title) {
    table <- copy(table)[is.finite(odds_ratio) & odds_ratio > 0]
    if (nrow(table) == 0) return(NULL)
    table[, category := factor(category, levels = rev(unique(category)))]
    table[, query := factor(query, levels = c("all hits", "higher", "lower"), labels = c("All hits", "Higher methylation", "Lower methylation"))]
    table[, ci_low := pmax(ci_low, 1e-3)]
    table[, ci_high := pmin(ci_high, 1e3)]
    ggplot(table, aes(odds_ratio, category, colour = query)) + geom_vline(xintercept = 1, colour = "grey40", linetype = 2) +
        geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = ci_low, xmax = ci_high), position = position_dodge(width = 0.6), size = 0.3) +
        scale_x_log10() + scale_colour_manual(values = c(`All hits` = "grey25", `Higher methylation` = "#b2182b", `Lower methylation` = "#2166ac")) +
        facet_grid(group ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") + theme(legend.position = "bottom", strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0)) +
        labs(x = "Odds ratio against all tested CpGs (log scale)", y = NULL, colour = NULL, title = title,
             subtitle = "Two-sided Fisher's exact test of the hits (FDR < 0.05) in each CpG island context and gene feature; bars show 95% confidence intervals. An odds ratio above 1 means the hits are over-represented there.")
}
# I5: methylation level of the hits
level_plot <- function(d, effect, title) {
    if (!"mean_beta" %in% names(d)) return(NULL)
    direction <- significant_direction(d, effect)
    groups <- rbind(data.table(group = "All tested CpGs", mean_beta = d[["mean_beta"]][seq_len(nrow(d)) %% 10 == 0]),
                    data.table(group = "Higher methylation (FDR < 0.05)", mean_beta = d[["mean_beta"]][direction == "higher"]),
                    data.table(group = "Lower methylation (FDR < 0.05)", mean_beta = d[["mean_beta"]][direction == "lower"]))[!is.na(mean_beta)]
    counts <- groups[, .N, by = group]
    groups <- groups[group %in% counts[N >= 5, group]]
    if (uniqueN(groups[["group"]]) < 2) return(NULL)
    groups[, group := factor(group, levels = c("All tested CpGs", "Higher methylation (FDR < 0.05)", "Lower methylation (FDR < 0.05)"))]
    groups[, group := factor(group, levels = rev(levels(group)))]
    ggplot(groups, aes(mean_beta, group, fill = group)) + geom_violin(colour = NA, alpha = 0.6, scale = "width") +
        geom_boxplot(width = 0.12, outlier.shape = NA, fill = "white") +
        scale_fill_manual(values = c(`All tested CpGs` = "grey60", `Higher methylation (FDR < 0.05)` = "#b2182b", `Lower methylation (FDR < 0.05)` = "#2166ac"), guide = "none") +
        scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) + theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10)) +
        labs(x = "Mean beta value over the arrays", y = NULL, title = title,
             subtitle = "Methylation level of the hits against all tested CpGs (every 10th shown). Hits at intermediate levels are typical of CpGs that differ between blood cell types.")
}
# Template of a gene and its CpG island, with every genomic context category
# that the context figures use, to read them by (not to scale)
schematic_shown <- FALSE
context_schematic <- function() {
    island <- data.table(label = c("Open sea", "Shelf", "Shore", "Island", "Shore", "Shelf", "Open sea"),
                         start = c(0, 7, 15, 23, 39, 47, 55), end = c(7, 15, 23, 39, 47, 55, 124))
    island[, fill := label]
    promoter <- data.table(label = c("TSS1500", "TSS200", "5'UTR", "3'UTR"), start = c(14, 24, 31, 97), end = c(24, 31, 38, 108))
    promoter[, fill := label]
    body <- data.table(label = c("Intergenic", "First exon", "Intron or other\ngene part", "Other\nexons", "Intron", "Other\nexons", "Intron", "Other exons", "Intergenic"),
                       start = c(0, 31, 42, 58, 66, 76, 84, 92, 108), end = c(14, 42, 58, 66, 76, 84, 92, 108, 124))
    body[, fill := ifelse(grepl("^Intron", label), "Intron", ifelse(grepl("^Other", label), "Other exons", label))]
    tracks <- rbind(island[, y := 4], promoter[, y := 2], body[, y := 1])
    # the gene: exons as boxes (thin: untranslated, thick: coding), introns as a line
    exons <- data.table(start = c(31, 38, 58, 76, 92, 97), end = c(38, 42, 66, 84, 97, 108), h = c(0.12, 0.22, 0.22, 0.22, 0.22, 0.12))
    set.seed(3)
    cpgs <- data.table(x = c(seq(23.5, 38.5, by = 0.55), sort(runif(45, 0, 124))))
    colours <- c(Island = "#1b7837", Shore = "#7fbf7b", Shelf = "#d9f0d3", `Open sea` = "#f4f4f4",
                 TSS1500 = "#fdb863", TSS200 = "#e08214", `5'UTR` = "#b2abd2", `3'UTR` = "#8073ac",
                 `First exon` = "#2166ac", `Other exons` = "#67a9cf", Intron = "#d1e5f0", Intergenic = "#e6e6e6")
    text_colour <- c(Island = "white", TSS200 = "white", `First exon` = "white", `3'UTR` = "white")
    tracks[, ink := ifelse(fill %in% names(text_colour), "white", "grey15")]
    ggplot() +
        geom_rect(data = tracks, aes(xmin = start, xmax = end, ymin = y - 0.32, ymax = y + 0.32, fill = fill), colour = "white", linewidth = 0.6) +
        geom_text(data = tracks, aes(x = (start + end) / 2, y = y, label = label, colour = ink), size = 3.1, lineheight = 0.85) +
        geom_segment(data = cpgs, aes(x = x, xend = x, y = 4.42, yend = 4.62), linewidth = 0.3, colour = "grey30") +
        annotate("segment", x = 0, xend = 124, y = 3, yend = 3, colour = "grey60", linewidth = 0.4, linetype = 2) +
        annotate("segment", x = 31, xend = 108, y = 3, yend = 3, colour = "grey20", linewidth = 0.8) +
        geom_rect(data = exons, aes(xmin = start, xmax = end, ymin = 3 - h, ymax = 3 + h), fill = "grey20") +
        annotate("segment", x = 31, xend = 31, y = 3.25, yend = 3.55, linewidth = 0.6) +
        annotate("segment", x = 31, xend = 35, y = 3.55, yend = 3.55, linewidth = 0.6, arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.12, "cm"), type = "closed")) +
        annotate("text", x = 36.6, y = 3.55, label = "TSS (transcription start site)", size = 3, hjust = 0) +
        annotate("text", x = 124, y = 3.3, label = "5' to 3'", size = 2.8, hjust = 1, colour = "grey30") +
        annotate("text", x = 0, y = 4.75, label = "CpGs (dense in the island)", size = 2.8, hjust = 0, colour = "grey30") +
        scale_fill_manual(values = colours, guide = "none") + scale_colour_identity() +
        scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(1, 2, 3, 4), labels = c("Exons and introns", "Promoters and UTRs", "Gene", "CpG island context"), limits = c(0.6, 4.85)) +
        scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = 0.005)) +
        theme_void() + theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 1, margin = margin(r = 6)), plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 5)) +
        labs(title = "How to read the genomic context: a gene and its CpG island",
             subtitle = paste("A template, not to scale, with every category of the context figures. CpG island context: the island itself, shores up to 2 kb from it,",
                              "shelves 2 to 4 kb from it, open sea farther away. Gene features: TSS1500 and TSS200 lie 200 to 1,500 and up to 200 bp upstream of the",
                              "transcription start site (TSS); the 5' and 3' untranslated regions (thin boxes) are parts of the first and last exons; CpGs in no annotated",
                              "gene are intergenic. A CpG can carry several features when the transcripts of a gene differ; in the context figures it counts in each."))
}
```

This report summarises one run of the [methylarray](https://github.com/bhagesh-h/methylarray) pipeline (Zenodo DOI [10.5281/zenodo.24399752](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24399752)`r if (nzchar(param("pipeline_version"))) paste0(", version ", param("pipeline_version")) else ""`). It shows aggregate results and plots; individual phenotype values are not printed. The full tables are in the pipeline's output folders, described in the pipeline's output documentation.

Use the search box above the contents to find any word in the report; tables are closed until their name is clicked, and a search opens the tables that hold a match. Figures are vector graphics, or 300 dpi images where they hold many points, so they stay sharp when zoomed; the same figures are saved as PNG and PDF files in `report/figures/`.

# Run summary

```{r summary}
qc <- if (has("^sample_qc\\.tsv$")) read(find("^sample_qc\\.tsv$")) else NULL
rows <- data.table(
    Item = c("Preprocessing", "Platform", "Arrays in the samplesheet", "Arrays retained for analysis", "Arrays failed", "Arrays excluded in the samplesheet", "Association models"),
    Value = c(param("preprocessing"), param("platform"),
              if (is.null(qc)) NA else nrow(qc),
              if (is.null(qc)) NA else sum(qc[["status"]] %in% c("PASS", "FLAG")),
              if (is.null(qc)) NA else sum(qc[["status"]] == "FAIL"),
              if (is.null(qc)) NA else sum(qc[["status"]] == "EXCLUDED"),
              length(find("^ewas_.*_top\\.tsv$")))
)
kable(rows, caption = "Run summary")
```

```{r snp, results = "asis", fig.width = 11, fig.height = 7, eval = has("^ewastools_snp_summary\\.tsv$")}
heading("SNP genotypes")
snp <- read(find("^ewastools_snp_summary\\.tsv$"))
hist_snp <- if (has("^ewastools_snp_histograms\\.tsv$")) read(find("^ewastools_snp_histograms\\.tsv$")) else NULL
threshold <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(param("snp_outlier_threshold")))
cat(sprintf("The SNP probes of the array give genotypes at %d autosomal SNPs; %d SNPs behave as X-chromosome SNPs (men almost never heterozygous). Highest agreement between two arrays: %.2f (median of each array's highest: %.2f); %d arrays share more than 90%% of their genotypes with another array. SNP outlier score above %s (possible contamination): %d arrays.\n\n",
            max(snp[["snps_autosomal"]], na.rm = TRUE), max(snp[["snps_x_like"]], na.rm = TRUE),
            max(snp[["max_agreement"]], na.rm = TRUE), median(snp[["max_agreement"]], na.rm = TRUE), sum(snp[["max_agreement"]] > 0.9, na.rm = TRUE),
            param("snp_outlier_threshold"), sum(snp[["snp_outlier"]] > threshold, na.rm = TRUE)))
if (!is.null(hist_snp) && nrow(hist_snp) > 0) {
    show_plot(ggplot(hist_snp[histogram == "snp_beta"], aes((bin_start + bin_end) / 2, count)) + geom_col(fill = "#4c72b0", width = 0.02) +
        geom_vline(xintercept = c(0.2, 0.8), linetype = 2, colour = "#c44e52") + labs(x = "Beta value of the autosomal SNP probes", y = "Genotype calls", title = "Beta values of the autosomal SNP probes", subtitle = "Three peaks are expected: both alleles of one kind, one of each, both of the other kind. Dashed lines at 0.2 and 0.8 separate the genotype calls."))
    show_plot(ggplot(hist_snp[histogram == "pair_agreement"], aes((bin_start + bin_end) / 2, count)) + geom_col(fill = "#55a868", width = 0.02) +
        geom_vline(xintercept = 0.9, linetype = 2, colour = "#c44e52") + labs(x = "Share of identical genotypes", y = "Pairs of arrays", title = "Genotype agreement of every pair of arrays", subtitle = "Pairs above the dashed line at 0.9 are most likely from the same person."))
}
if (any(!is.na(snp[["het_share_x"]]))) {
    show_plot(ggplot(snp[!is.na(het_share_x) & sex_used %in% c("M", "F")], aes(ifelse(sex_used == "M", "Men", "Women"), het_share_x)) +
        geom_jitter(width = 0.2, height = 0, alpha = 0.5, colour = "#8172b3") + labs(x = "Sex used for the check", y = "Share of heterozygous X-chromosome SNPs", title = "Heterozygosity at the X-chromosome SNPs by sex", subtitle = "Men have one X chromosome and are almost never heterozygous; a man with many heterozygous calls suggests contamination or a sample swap."))
}
show_plot(ggplot(snp, aes(snp_outlier)) + geom_histogram(bins = 40, fill = "#dd8452") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = threshold, linetype = 2, colour = "#c44e52") +
    labs(x = "SNP outlier score (higher: more likely contaminated)", y = "Arrays", title = "SNP outlier score of every array", subtitle = "ewastools score of how far the SNP probe betas lie from the three genotype peaks; arrays above the dashed line fail QC."))
```

```{r relatedness, results = "asis", fig.width = 9, fig.height = 6, eval = has("^ewastools_relatedness\\.tsv\\.gz$") && has("^ewastools_relatedness_summary\\.tsv$")}
heading("Relatedness")
rs <- read(find("^ewastools_relatedness_summary\\.tsv$"))
rv <- setNames(rs[["value"]], rs[["metric"]])
pairs <- read(find("^ewastools_relatedness\\.tsv\\.gz$"))
cat(sprintf("Every pair of the %s arrays below the SNP outlier threshold, from %s autosomal SNPs: %s pairs. A pair is related when its log10 likelihood ratio against unrelated exceeds %s (at most a 5%% chance of any false call). Identical pairs: %s, of them %s from different expected donors; first-degree pairs: %s; replicate pairs that are not identical: %s.\n\n",
            rv[["arrays"]], rv[["snps"]], format(as.numeric(rv[["pairs"]]), big.mark = ","), rv[["lod_threshold"]], rv[["identical_pairs"]],
            rv[["identical_pairs_unexpected"]], rv[["first_degree_pairs"]], rv[["replicate_pairs_not_identical"]]))
if (is.finite(as.numeric(rv[["expected_lod_first_degree"]])) && as.numeric(rv[["expected_lod_first_degree"]]) < as.numeric(rv[["lod_threshold"]])) {
    cat(sprintf("A true first-degree pair is expected to reach a log10 likelihood ratio of only %s with these SNPs, below the threshold, so most first-degree relatives are missed. Identical pairs are detected reliably. Genotypes from more SNPs (for example a genotyping array) are needed to find relatives.\n\n",
                rv[["expected_lod_first_degree"]]))
}
if (nrow(pairs) > 0) {
    pairs[, Relation := factor(relation, levels = c("unrelated", "first-degree", "identical", "too few SNPs"))]
    setorder(pairs, Relation)
    show_plot(ggplot(pairs, aes(ibs_mean, ibs_var, colour = Relation)) +
        geom_point(size = 0.8, alpha = 0.6) +
        geom_point(data = pairs[expected_same_donor == TRUE], shape = 1, size = 3, colour = "black") +
        scale_colour_manual(values = c(unrelated = "#999999", `first-degree` = "#dd8452", identical = "#c44e52", `too few SNPs` = "#cccccc"), drop = FALSE) +
        labs(x = "Mean identity by state (alleles shared per SNP)", y = "Variance of identity by state", colour = "Inferred relation",
             title = "Relatedness of every pair of arrays", subtitle = "Black circles: pairs expected to be the same donor (replicate_group)"))
    shown <- pairs[relation %in% c("identical", "first-degree") | expected_same_donor == TRUE]
    if (nrow(shown) > 0) {
        print(kable(shown[, .(`Array 1` = sample1, `Array 2` = sample2, Relation = relation, `Same donor expected` = ifelse(expected_same_donor, "yes", "no"),
                              `IBS mean` = ibs_mean, `LOD identical` = lod_identical, `LOD first-degree` = lod_first_degree)],
                    caption = "Related pairs and expected replicate pairs"))
    }
}
```

```{r ancestry, results = "asis", fig.width = 9, fig.height = 5, eval = has("^ancestry_pcs_summary\\.tsv$")}
heading("Genetic ancestry")
as_summary <- read(find("^ancestry_pcs_summary\\.tsv$"))
av <- setNames(as.character(as_summary[["value"]]), as_summary[["metric"]])
if ("note" %in% names(av)) {
    cat(av[["note"]], "\n\n")
} else {
    cat(sprintf("Ancestry components from %s CpG probes with a common SNP and %s rs probes on %s arrays (EpiAnceR+ approach), with the CpG beta values residualised for: %s. The components marked as covariates are added to models with `@ancestry`.\n\n",
                av[["snp_cpgs"]], av[["rs_snps"]], av[["arrays"]], av[["residualised_for"]]))
    pcs <- read(find("^ancestry_pcs\\.tsv$"))
    if (all(c("ancestry_pc1", "ancestry_pc2") %in% names(pcs))) {
        show_plot(ggplot(pcs, aes(ancestry_pc1, ancestry_pc2)) + geom_point(size = 1.5, alpha = 0.7, colour = "#4c72b0") +
            labs(x = "Ancestry PC1", y = "Ancestry PC2", title = "Arrays on the first two genetic ancestry components", subtitle = "Components from the CpGs with a common SNP and the rs probes (EpiAnceR+ approach); clusters suggest groups of different genetic ancestry."))
    }
    if (has("^ancestry_pcs_variance\\.tsv$")) {
        av_var <- read(find("^ancestry_pcs_variance\\.tsv$"))
        av_var[, pc := factor(sub("ancestry_", "", pc), levels = sub("ancestry_", "", pc))]
        show_plot(ggplot(av_var, aes(pc, 100 * variance_explained, fill = covariate)) + geom_col() +
            scale_fill_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "#4c72b0", `FALSE` = "#bbbbbb"), labels = c(`TRUE` = "@ancestry covariate", `FALSE` = "not used")) +
            labs(x = NULL, y = "Variance explained (%)", fill = NULL, title = "Variance of each ancestry component"))
    }
    if (has("^ancestry_pcs_associations\\.tsv$")) {
        aa <- read(find("^ancestry_pcs_associations\\.tsv$"))
        if (nrow(aa) > 0) {
            aa[, pc := factor(sub("ancestry_", "", pc), levels = unique(sub("ancestry_", "", pc)))]
            show_plot(ggplot(aa, aes(pc, variable, fill = r_squared)) + geom_tile(colour = "white") +
                geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", r_squared)), size = 2.6) +
                scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "#c44e52", limits = c(0, 1)) +
                labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "R-squared", title = "What the ancestry components capture",
                     subtitle = "Technical variables (plate, BeadChip, row) should explain little after the residualisation"))
        }
    }
}
```

# Probe filtering

```{r attrition, results = "asis", eval = has("_filtered_attrition\\.tsv$")}
attrition <- read(find("_filtered_attrition\\.tsv$")[1])
steps <- attrition[step != "start" & !startsWith(step, "report_only_")]
steps[, step := factor(step, levels = rev(step))]
cat(sprintf("%s probes at the start, %s kept after filtering.\n\n", format(attrition[step == "start", remaining], big.mark = ","),
            format(tail(steps[["remaining"]], 1), big.mark = ",")))
show_plot(ggplot(steps, aes(removed, step)) + geom_col(fill = "#4c72b0") +
    scale_x_continuous(labels = function(x) format(x, big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE)) +
    labs(x = "Probes removed", y = "Filter step", title = "Probes removed at each filter step",
         subtitle = "Steps in the order they are applied, from top to bottom; a probe is counted at the first step that removes it."), 8, 4.5)
print(kable(attrition[startsWith(step, "report_only_"), .(Flag = sub("report_only_", "", step), `Kept probes with the flag` = n_with_reason)], caption = "Report-only flags: probes kept although flagged"))
```

```{r cells, results = "asis", eval = has("^cell_fractions\\.tsv$")}
heading("Cell composition")
cells <- read(find("^cell_fractions\\.tsv$"))
long <- melt(cells[, c("sample", grep("^lineage_", names(cells), value = TRUE)), with = FALSE], id.vars = "sample")
long[, variable := sub("^lineage_", "", variable)]
show_plot(ggplot(long, aes(variable, value)) + geom_boxplot(fill = "#dd8452", outlier.size = 0.8) +
    labs(x = "Cell lineage", y = "Estimated fraction", title = "Blood cell lineage fractions over the arrays", subtitle = "EpiDISH robust partial correlations with the 12-cell-type reference cent12CT, summed into six lineages; boxes show the median and quartiles."))
if (has("^cell_fractions_reference_coverage\\.tsv$")) {
    rc <- read(find("^cell_fractions_reference_coverage\\.tsv$"))
    print(kable(rc[, .(Reference = reference, `Reference CpGs` = reference_cpgs, `On sex chromosomes` = sex_chromosome, Found = found,
                       Coverage = coverage, Status = status)], caption = "Reference CpGs found in the data"))
}
if (has("^cell_fractions_idol_agreement\\.tsv$") && any(startsWith(names(cells), "idol_"))) {
    idol_pairs <- c(B = "Bcell", CD4T = "CD4T", CD8T = "CD8T", NK = "NK", Mono = "Mono", Gran = "Neu")
    both <- rbindlist(lapply(names(idol_pairs), function(l) {
        if (!all(c(paste0("lineage_", l), paste0("idol_", idol_pairs[[l]])) %in% names(cells))) return(NULL)
        data.table(lineage = paste(l, "/", idol_pairs[[l]]), cent12 = cells[[paste0("lineage_", l)]], idol = cells[[paste0("idol_", idol_pairs[[l]])]])
    }))
    cat("\n\nCross-check with the IDOL reference (FlowSorted.Blood.EPIC, Houseman constrained projection): each cent12CT lineage against the matching IDOL cell type. Granulocytes include eosinophils and basophils, IDOL neutrophils do not.\n\n")
    show_plot(ggplot(both, aes(idol, cent12)) + geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, colour = "grey60", linetype = 2) +
        geom_point(size = 1, alpha = 0.6, colour = "#4c72b0") + facet_wrap(~lineage, scales = "free") +
        labs(x = "IDOL fraction", y = "EpiDISH cent12CT fraction", title = "Cell fractions from cent12CT against the IDOL reference", subtitle = "One panel per lineage; the dashed line is identity."))
    print(kable(read(find("^cell_fractions_idol_agreement\\.tsv$")), caption = "Agreement of the lineages with IDOL (Spearman rho, mean difference)"))
}
```

```{r clocks, results = "asis", eval = has("^clocks\\.tsv$") || has("^dnam_scores_coverage\\.tsv$")}
heading("Epigenetic clocks and DNA methylation scores")
if (has("^clocks_coverage\\.tsv$")) {
    coverage <- read(find("^clocks_coverage\\.tsv$"))
    print(kable(coverage[, .(Clock = clock, CpGs = cpgs, Present = present, `Share present` = share_present, Note = note)], caption = "Clock coverage"))
}
if (has("^clocks\\.tsv$")) {
    clocks <- read(find("^clocks\\.tsv$"))
    values <- setdiff(names(clocks), c("sample", "age", grep("^i?eaa_", names(clocks), value = TRUE)))
    if (sum(!is.na(clocks[["age"]])) >= 3) {
        agreement <- rbindlist(lapply(values, function(clock) {
            ok <- !is.na(clocks[[clock]]) & !is.na(clocks[["age"]])
            if (sum(ok) < 3) return(NULL)
            data.table(Clock = clock, Arrays = sum(ok), `Pearson r with age` = round(cor(clocks[[clock]][ok], clocks[["age"]][ok]), 3))
        }))
        print(kable(agreement, caption = "Agreement of the clocks with the reported age"))
        main <- intersect(c("HorvathS2013", "HannumG2013", "LevineM2018", "HorvathS2018", "PCGrimAge", "PCPhenoAge"), values)
        if (length(main) > 0) {
            long <- melt(clocks[, c("sample", "age", main), with = FALSE], id.vars = c("sample", "age"), variable.name = "clock")[is.finite(value) & is.finite(age)]
            show_plot(ggplot(long, aes(age, value)) + geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, colour = "grey60", linetype = 2) +
                geom_point(size = 0.9, alpha = 0.6, colour = "#4c72b0") + geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ x, se = FALSE, colour = "#c44e52", linewidth = 0.6) +
                facet_wrap(~clock, scales = "free_y") +
                labs(x = "Reported age", y = "Clock estimate (years)", title = "Age clocks against the reported age", subtitle = "One panel per clock; dashed line: identity; red line: linear fit."))
        }
    }
    accelerations <- grep("^eaa_", names(clocks), value = TRUE)
    if (length(accelerations) > 0) {
        long <- melt(clocks[, c("sample", accelerations), with = FALSE], id.vars = "sample", variable.name = "clock")[is.finite(value)]
        long[, clock := factor(sub("^eaa_", "", clock), levels = rev(sub("^eaa_", "", accelerations)))]
        show_plot(ggplot(long, aes(value, clock)) + geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey60") +
            geom_violin(fill = "#4c72b0", colour = NA, alpha = 0.5, scale = "width") + geom_boxplot(width = 0.15, outlier.size = 0.6, fill = "white") +
            labs(x = "Age acceleration (years; residual of the clock on reported age)", y = "Clock", title = "Epigenetic age acceleration over the arrays", subtitle = "Violins show the distribution, boxes the median and quartiles; 0 means a clock estimate as expected for the reported age."))
    }
}
if (has("^dnam_scores_coverage\\.tsv$")) {
    scores_coverage <- read(find("^dnam_scores_coverage\\.tsv$"))
    print(kable(scores_coverage[, .(Score = score, CpGs = cpgs, Present = present, `Share present` = share_present, Reference = reference)], caption = "DNA methylation score coverage"))
}
if (has("^dnam_scores\\.tsv$")) {
    scores <- read(find("^dnam_scores\\.tsv$"))
    long <- melt(scores, id.vars = "sample", variable.name = "score")[is.finite(value)]
    if (nrow(long) > 0) {
        long[, score := sub("^dnam_", "", score)]
        show_plot(ggplot(long, aes(score, value)) + geom_violin(fill = "#dd8452", colour = NA, alpha = 0.5, scale = "width") +
            geom_boxplot(width = 0.15, outlier.size = 0.6, fill = "white") + facet_wrap(~score, scales = "free", nrow = 1) +
            theme(axis.text.x = element_blank()) +
            labs(x = NULL, y = "Score", title = "DNA methylation scores over the arrays", subtitle = "Each score on its own scale"))
    }
}
```


```{r clock-weights, results = "asis", fig.width = 12, fig.height = 12, eval = has("^clocks_weights\\.tsv$") || has("^dnam_scores_weights\\.tsv$")}
heading("Clock and score CpGs")
cat("Standardised weight: the published coefficient of a CpG times the SD of its beta value in these arrays, in the clock's own units per SD of methylation. The largest ones show which CpGs drive each clock in this data. Principal-component clocks and epiTOC2 have no per-CpG weights.\n\n")
weights <- rbindlist(list(
    if (has("^clocks_weights\\.tsv$")) read(find("^clocks_weights\\.tsv$"))[, .(set = clock, cpg, gene = as.character(gene), standardised)] else NULL,
    if (has("^dnam_scores_weights\\.tsv$")) read(find("^dnam_scores_weights\\.tsv$"))[, .(set = paste("score", score), cpg, gene = NA_character_, standardised)] else NULL
), fill = TRUE)
weights <- weights[is.finite(standardised)]
if (nrow(weights) > 0) {
    top <- weights[order(-abs(standardised)), head(.SD, 12), by = set]
    top[, label := paste0(cpg, ifelse(is.na(gene) | gene == "", "", paste0(" (", gene, ")")))]
    top[, key := paste(set, label, sep = "__")]
    top[, key := factor(key, levels = rev(unique(key)))]
    show_plot(ggplot(top, aes(standardised, key, fill = standardised > 0)) + geom_col() +
        scale_y_discrete(labels = function(x) sub("^.*__", "", x)) +
        scale_fill_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "#c44e52", `FALSE` = "#4c72b0"), guide = "none") +
        facet_wrap(~ set, scales = "free", ncol = 3) + theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6)) +
        labs(x = "Standardised weight (clock units per SD of beta)", y = NULL, title = "The 12 largest standardised weights of each clock and score"))
}
if (has("^clocks_coverage\\.tsv$")) {
    coverage <- read(find("^clocks_coverage\\.tsv$"))
    if ("snp_cpgs" %in% names(coverage) && any(coverage[["cpgs"]] > 0)) {
        show_plot(ggplot(coverage[cpgs > 0], aes(100 * snp_cpgs / cpgs, reorder(clock, snp_cpgs / cpgs))) + geom_col(fill = "#dd8452") +
            labs(x = "% of the clock's CpGs with a common SNP at the CpG or extension base", y = NULL, title = "SNPs under the clocks' CpGs"))
    }
}
```

```{r meqtl, results = "asis", fig.width = 11, fig.height = 8, eval = has("^meqtl_cpgs_summary\\.tsv$")}
heading("Genetic influence on the clocks")
ms <- read(find("^meqtl_cpgs_summary\\.tsv$"))
mv <- setNames(as.character(ms[["value"]]), ms[["metric"]])
cat(sprintf("The meQTL table (`--meqtl`) gives %s CpGs with a cis-meQTL (%s associations kept of %s); %s of them are on this array. Clock CpGs whose methylation depends on a nearby genotype carry inherited variation into the clock, and their allele frequencies differ between ancestries (Meeks et al. 2025).\n\n",
            mv[["cpgs_in_table"]], mv[["rows_kept"]], mv[["rows_read"]], mv[["cpgs_on_array"]]))
if (has("^clocks_weights\\.tsv$")) {
    w <- read(find("^clocks_weights\\.tsv$"))
    if ("meqtl" %in% names(w) && any(!is.na(w[["meqtl"]]))) {
        w <- w[is.finite(standardised)]
        w[, class := ifelse(meqtl %in% TRUE, "cis-meQTL", ifelse(snp %in% TRUE, "SNP in the probe", "neither"))]
        shares <- w[, .(share = sum(abs(standardised))), by = .(clock, class)][, share := 100 * share / sum(share), by = clock]
        shares[, class := factor(class, levels = c("cis-meQTL", "SNP in the probe", "neither"))]
        show_plot(ggplot(shares, aes(share, clock, fill = class)) + geom_col() +
            scale_fill_manual(values = c(`cis-meQTL` = "#c44e52", `SNP in the probe` = "#dd8452", neither = "#bbbbbb")) +
            labs(x = "% of the clock's absolute standardised weight", y = "Clock", fill = "CpG class", title = "Clock weight on CpGs under genetic influence"))
    }
}
if (has("^clocks_robust\\.tsv$") && has("^clocks\\.tsv$")) {
    full <- read(find("^clocks\\.tsv$"))
    rob <- read(find("^clocks_robust\\.tsv$"))
    shown <- intersect(grep("^eaa_", names(full), value = TRUE), names(rob))
    value_of <- function(table, columns) melt(table[, c("sample", columns), with = FALSE], id.vars = "sample", variable.name = "clock")
    if (length(shown) == 0) shown <- intersect(c("HorvathS2013", "HannumG2013", "LevineM2018", "DunedinPACE"), intersect(names(full), names(rob)))
    if (length(shown) > 0) {
        both <- merge(value_of(full, shown), value_of(rob, shown), by = c("sample", "clock"), suffixes = c("_full", "_robust"))
        both <- both[is.finite(value_full) & is.finite(value_robust)]
        rho <- both[, .(rho = suppressWarnings(cor(value_full, value_robust, method = "spearman"))), by = clock]
        both <- merge(both, rho, by = "clock")
        both[, panel := sprintf("%s (rho %.2f)", sub("^eaa_", "", clock), rho)]
        show_plot(ggplot(both, aes(value_full, value_robust)) + geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, colour = "grey60", linetype = 2) +
            geom_point(size = 0.8, alpha = 0.6, colour = "#4c72b0") + facet_wrap(~panel, scales = "free") +
            labs(x = if (startsWith(shown[1], "eaa_")) "Acceleration, full clock" else "Clock value, full clock",
                 y = "Without SNP and cis-meQTL CpGs", title = "Genotype-robust clocks",
                 subtitle = "CpGs with a common SNP or a cis-meQTL held at their mean; the phenotype tests of both versions are in the forest plots"))
    }
}
if (has("^ewas_summary_meqtl\\.tsv$")) {
    em <- read(find("^ewas_summary_meqtl\\.tsv$"))
    if (nrow(em) > 0) print(kable(em[, .(Model = model, Contrast = contrast, `Hits (FDR < 0.05)` = hits_fdr, `Hits with a cis-meQTL` = hits_meqtl,
                                         `Share of hits` = share_hits, `Share of tested CpGs` = share_tested, `Odds ratio` = odds_ratio, P = p_value)],
                               caption = "Association hits with a cis-meQTL: candidates for genetic confounding, especially without ancestry covariates"))
}
```

```{r contamination, results = "asis", fig.width = 11, fig.height = 7, eval = has("^biomarkers_contamination\\.tsv$") && !is.null(qc) && "snp_outlier" %in% names(qc)}
ct <- read(find("^biomarkers_contamination\\.tsv$"))
if (nrow(ct) > 0) {
    heading("Contamination and the ageing measures")
    cutoff <- ct[["cutoff"]][1]
    threshold <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(param("snp_outlier_threshold")))
    cat(sprintf("DNA from another person pulls beta values towards the middle and can bias clocks. Arrays with a SNP outlier score above %s fail QC; among the analysed arrays, %d lie above the robust cutoff of %.2f (median plus three MADs). The phenotype associations without them are the 'low contamination' version in the tables and forest plots above. Correlations of the score with the measures at q < 0.05: %d of %d.\n\n",
                param("snp_outlier_threshold"), ct[["arrays_above_cutoff"]][1], cutoff, sum(ct[["q"]] < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE), nrow(ct)))
    print(kable(ct[, .(Measure = measure, `Spearman rho` = rho, q = signif(q, 3), Arrays = n)], caption = "SNP outlier score against the accelerations and scores"))
    if (has("^clocks\\.tsv$")) {
        cl <- read(find("^clocks\\.tsv$"))
        main <- intersect(c("HorvathS2013", "HannumG2013", "LevineM2018", "PCGrimAge", "DunedinPACE"), names(cl))
        long <- rbindlist(lapply(main, function(k) {
            column <- if (paste0("eaa_", k) %in% names(cl)) paste0("eaa_", k) else k
            data.table(sample = cl[["sample"]], panel = if (column == k) k else paste(k, "acceleration"), value = as.numeric(cl[[column]]))
        }))
        long <- merge(long, qc[, .(sample, snp_outlier, status)], by = "sample")[is.finite(value) & is.finite(snp_outlier)]
        if (nrow(long) > 0) {
            rho <- long[, .(label = sprintf("%s (rho %.2f)", panel[1], suppressWarnings(cor(snp_outlier, value, method = "spearman")))), by = panel]
            long <- merge(long, rho, by = "panel")
            show_plot(ggplot(long, aes(snp_outlier, value)) + geom_point(aes(colour = status), size = 1, alpha = 0.6) +
                geom_vline(xintercept = cutoff, linetype = 2, colour = "#dd8452") +
                geom_vline(xintercept = threshold, linetype = 2, colour = "#c44e52") +
                facet_wrap(~label, scales = "free_y") +
                labs(x = "SNP outlier score (higher = more likely contaminated)", y = NULL, colour = "QC status",
                     title = "Contamination against the main clocks", subtitle = "Orange line: robust cutoff of the analysed arrays; red line: FAIL threshold"))
        }
    }
}
```

```{r quartiles, results = "asis", fig.width = 14, fig.height = 12, eval = has("^biomarkers_quartiles\\.tsv$")}
qt <- read(find("^biomarkers_quartiles\\.tsv$"))
if (nrow(qt) > 0) {
    heading("Quartile groups of acceleration")
    cat("For each clock: the bottom quarter of acceleration (low, decelerated), the middle half (mid) and the top quarter (high, accelerated). Numbers: medians, or percentages for binary traits. Colour: mean z of the trait in the group. Stars in the trend column: trend across the groups (Kendall's tau), q < 0.05, 0.01, 0.001 over the traits.\n\n")
    qt[, group := factor(group, levels = c("decelerated", "normal", "accelerated"), labels = c("low", "mid", "high"))]
    qt[, measure := sub(" acceleration$", "", measure)]
    # the stars sit in their own column inside each panel, so they never run into the next panel
    groups <- c("low", "mid", "high", "trend")
    qt[, group := factor(as.character(group), levels = groups)]
    lab <- unique(qt[, .(measure, trait, star = stars(q))])
    lab[, group := factor("trend", levels = groups)]
    n_measures <- uniqueN(qt[["measure"]])
    columns <- min(4, n_measures)
    # many phenotypes are split over several figures, each at most about 30 inches high
    rows <- ceiling(n_measures / columns)
    per_part <- min(24, max(5, floor((30 / rows - 0.8) / 0.26)))
    traits <- unique(qt[["trait"]])
    parts <- split(traits, ceiling(seq_along(traits) / per_part))
    for (i in seq_along(parts)) {
        part <- qt[trait %in% parts[[i]]]
        show_plot(ggplot(part, aes(group, trait)) + geom_tile(aes(fill = mean_z), colour = "white") + geom_text(aes(label = signif(value, 3)), size = 2.4) +
            geom_text(data = lab[trait %in% parts[[i]]], aes(x = group, y = trait, label = star), colour = "#b2182b", size = 3.4, fontface = "bold") +
            scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE) + facet_wrap(~ measure, ncol = columns) +
            scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#4c72b0", high = "#c44e52", limits = c(-0.8, 0.8), oob = scales::squish) +
            theme(panel.spacing.x = unit(1.5, "lines"), panel.spacing.y = unit(1, "lines"), panel.grid = element_blank(),
                  legend.position = "bottom", legend.key.width = unit(2.5, "cm"), legend.title = element_text(vjust = 0.8),
                  legend.margin = margin(t = 10)) +
            labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "Mean z of the trait in the group",
                 title = paste0("Characteristics by quartile group of acceleration", if (length(parts) > 1) sprintf(" (part %d of %d)", i, length(parts))),
                 subtitle = "Columns: low (bottom quarter), mid (middle half) and high (top quarter) of the acceleration; trend: stars for the trend across the groups (Kendall's tau), q < 0.05, 0.01, 0.001."),
            4 * columns, 1.5 + rows * (0.8 + 0.26 * length(parts[[i]])))
    }
}
```

```{r pca, results = "asis", fig.width = 11, fig.height = 10, eval = has("^pca_variance\\.tsv$")}
heading("Exploratory analysis")
variance <- read(find("^pca_variance\\.tsv$"))
show_plot(ggplot(variance, aes(factor(pc, levels = pc), variance_explained, fill = tested)) + geom_col() +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "#4c72b0", `FALSE` = "#bbbbbb")) +
    labs(x = "Principal component", y = "Share of variance", fill = "Tested for\nassociations", title = "Variance explained by the principal components of the most variable CpGs"))
associations <- read(find("^pca_associations\\.tsv$"))
if (nrow(associations) > 0) {
    shares <- setNames(variance[["variance_explained"]], variance[["pc"]])
    pcs <- unique(associations[["pc"]])
    pcs <- pcs[order(as.integer(sub("^PC", "", pcs)))]
    associations[, pc := factor(pc, levels = pcs)]
    if (!"adj_r_squared" %in% names(associations)) associations[, adj_r_squared := r_squared]
    show_plot(ggplot(associations, aes(pc, variable, fill = pmax(adj_r_squared, 0))) + geom_tile(colour = "white") +
        geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(p_value < 0.001, sprintf("%.2f", adj_r_squared), "")), size = 2.6) +
        scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "#c44e52", limits = c(0, NA)) +
        scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) sprintf("%s (%.1f%%)", x, 100 * shares[x])) +
        facet_grid(group ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
        theme(strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0), axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9), axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1, size = 9)) +
        labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "Adjusted\nR-squared", title = "What the main axes of methylation variation follow",
             subtitle = "Adjusted R-squared of each variable for each principal component (corrected for the number of levels); numbers where P < 0.001. Under each PC: its share of the variance."),
        12, max(5, 1.6 + 0.24 * uniqueN(associations[["variable"]])))
}
if (has("^pca_scores\\.tsv$")) {
    pc_scores <- read(find("^pca_scores\\.tsv$"))
    if (all(c("PC1", "PC2") %in% names(pc_scores))) {
        sex_column <- if (is.null(qc)) character() else head(intersect(c("predicted_sex_ewastools", "predicted_sex_minfi", "reported_sex"), names(qc)), 1)
        pc_scores[, group := "all arrays"]
        if (length(sex_column) == 1) {
            pc_scores <- merge(pc_scores, qc[, c("sample", sex_column), with = FALSE], by = "sample", all.x = TRUE)
            pc_scores[, group := ifelse(is.na(get(sex_column)), "unknown", as.character(get(sex_column)))]
        }
        pc_scores[, outlier := FALSE]
        if (has("^pca_outliers\\.tsv$")) pc_scores[, outlier := sample %in% read(find("^pca_outliers\\.tsv$"))[pca_outlier %in% TRUE, sample]]
        axis_label <- function(pc) {
            share <- variance[["variance_explained"]][match(pc, variance[["pc"]])]
            if (is.na(share)) pc else sprintf("%s (%.1f%%)", pc, 100 * share)
        }
        show_plot(ggplot(pc_scores, aes(PC1, PC2, colour = group, shape = outlier)) + geom_point(size = 1.6, alpha = 0.8) +
            scale_shape_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = 16, `TRUE` = 4), labels = c(`FALSE` = "no", `TRUE` = "yes")) +
            labs(x = axis_label("PC1"), y = axis_label("PC2"), colour = if (length(sex_column) == 1) "Sex" else NULL, shape = "PCA outlier",
                 title = "Arrays on the first two principal components"))
    }
}
if (has("^pca_outliers\\.tsv$")) {
    outliers <- read(find("^pca_outliers\\.tsv$"))
    flagged <- outliers[pca_outlier %in% TRUE]
    cat("\n\nOutliers on PC1 and PC2 (robust Mahalanobis distance above the chi-square 0.999 quantile; reported, not removed): ",
        if (nrow(flagged) > 0) paste(flagged[["sample"]], collapse = ", ") else "none", ".\n\n", sep = "")
}
```

```{r ewas-summary, results = "asis", eval = has("^ewas_summary\\.tsv$")}
heading("Association models")
ewas <- read(find("^ewas_summary\\.tsv$"))
columns <- intersect(c("model", "contrast", "status", "n", "lambda", "bacon_inflation", "bacon_bias", "hits_fdr", "hits_higher", "hits_lower", "hits_epigenome_wide", "hits_suggestive", "hits_study_wide", "top_cpg", "top_p"), names(ewas))
print(kable(ewas[, ..columns], caption = "Results of every model contrast"))
checks <- rbindlist(lapply(find("^ewas_.*_design_check\\.tsv$"), function(file) {
    if (file.info(file)[["size"]] == 0) return(NULL)
    d <- read(file)
    if (nrow(d) == 0) return(NULL)
    d[, model := model_of(file, "ewas_", "_design_check\\.tsv")]
}), fill = TRUE)
if (nrow(checks) > 0) {
    flagged <- checks[!is.na(flag) & nzchar(flag)]
    cat("\n\nDesign checks: the trait against the DNA plate and Sentrix row (Kruskal-Wallis or Fisher P; flagged as confounded at P < 0.01), the variance inflation factor of every design column (flagged as collinear above 10), and every numeric covariate against the trait (Spearman rho for a continuous trait, R-squared otherwise). Methylation-derived covariates (cell fractions, control-probe and ancestry PCs, DNA methylation scores, PCs) that follow the trait at P < 0.001 are flagged: adjusting for an axis that the trait itself drives can absorb the association (Uddin et al. 2022). A confounded or collinear term makes its own coefficient unstable and can absorb or create part of the trait effect. ",
        if (nrow(flagged) == 0) "No check was flagged.\n\n" else sprintf("Flagged checks: %d.\n\n", nrow(flagged)), sep = "")
    if (nrow(flagged) > 0) print(kable(flagged[, .(Model = model, Check = check, Value = value, P = signif(p_value, 3), Flag = flag)], caption = "Flagged design checks"))
}
if ("meff" %in% names(ewas) && any(!is.na(ewas[["meff"]]))) {
    cat("\n\nEffective number of independent tests across the models (Meff, Galwey 2009): ", ewas[["meff"]][!is.na(ewas[["meff"]])][1],
        "; study-wide threshold P < ", ewas[["p_study_wide"]][!is.na(ewas[["p_study_wide"]])][1], " (hits_study_wide).\n\n", sep = "")
}
if (has("^ewas_summary_comparison\\.tsv$")) {
    comparison <- read(find("^ewas_summary_comparison\\.tsv$"))
    if (nrow(comparison) > 0) {
        cat("\n\nComparison of the model contrasts (Uddin et al. 2022): shared hits against chance, and the correlation of the t statistics over all CpGs and over the hits of either contrast. A correlation that is low over all CpGs but high over the hits means the contrasts share a specific signal rather than a genome-wide one.\n\n")
        print(kable(comparison[, .(`Contrast A` = contrast_a, `Contrast B` = contrast_b, `Hits A` = hits_a, `Hits B` = hits_b, Shared = shared,
                                   `Share of A` = share_of_a, `Same direction` = same_direction, `Odds ratio` = odds_ratio, `P (overlap)` = p_overlap,
                                   `r (all CpGs)` = r_all, `r (hits)` = r_hits)], caption = "Overlap and agreement of every pair of model contrasts"))
        pairs <- head(comparison, 6)
        stats_files <- find("^ewas_.*_stats\\.tsv\\.gz$")
        all_stats <- rbindlist(lapply(stats_files, function(f) {
            x <- read(f)
            if (nrow(x) == 0) return(NULL)
            x[, .(key = paste(model_of(f, "ewas_", "_stats\\.tsv\\.gz"), contrast, sep = " | "), cpg_id, t, hit = !is.na(fdr) & fdr < 0.05)]
        }))
        scatter <- rbindlist(lapply(seq_len(nrow(pairs)), function(i) {
            a <- all_stats[key == pairs[["contrast_a"]][i], .(cpg_id, t_a = t, hit_a = hit)]
            b <- all_stats[key == pairs[["contrast_b"]][i], .(cpg_id, t_b = t, hit_b = hit)]
            both <- merge(a, b, by = "cpg_id")
            both <- both[hit_a | hit_b | seq_len(.N) %% 50 == 0]
            both[, `:=`(pair = paste(pairs[["contrast_a"]][i], "vs", pairs[["contrast_b"]][i]),
                        class = factor(ifelse(hit_a & hit_b, "Hit in both", ifelse(hit_a | hit_b, "Hit in one", "Neither (every 50th)")),
                                       levels = c("Neither (every 50th)", "Hit in one", "Hit in both")))]
        }))
        if (nrow(scatter) > 0) {
            show_plot(ggplot(scatter[order(class)], aes(t_a, t_b, colour = class)) + geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey60") + geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey60") +
                      geom_point(size = 0.7, alpha = 0.8) + facet_wrap(~ pair, scales = "free") +
                      scale_colour_manual(values = c(`Neither (every 50th)` = "grey75", `Hit in one` = "#4c72b0", `Hit in both` = "#b2182b")) +
                      guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 2.5))) + theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
                      labs(x = "t statistic, first contrast", y = "t statistic, second contrast", colour = NULL,
                           title = "t statistics of every pair of model contrasts",
                           subtitle = "Each point is a CpG; hits are CpGs at FDR < 0.05. Points along the diagonal agree in direction and strength."),
                      9, 3 + 3 * ceiling(nrow(pairs) / 3))
        }
    }
}
```

```{r ewas-models, results = "asis", eval = has("^ewas_.*_stats\\.tsv\\.gz$")}
for (file in find("^ewas_.*_stats\\.tsv\\.gz$")) {
    model <- model_of(file, "ewas_", "_stats\\.tsv\\.gz")
    stats <- read(file)
    if (nrow(stats) == 0) next
    cat("\n\n## Model", model, "\n\n")
    characteristics_file <- sub("_stats\\.tsv\\.gz$", "_characteristics.tsv", file)
    if (file.exists(characteristics_file) && file.info(characteristics_file)[["size"]] > 0) {
        characteristics <- read(characteristics_file)
        if (nrow(characteristics) > 0) {
            setnames(characteristics, c("variable", "level", "p_value"), c("Variable", "Level", "P"), skip_absent = TRUE)
            print(kable(characteristics, caption = paste0(model, ": characteristics of the arrays in the model (aggregates; counts below 5 shown as <5; P: Kruskal-Wallis or Fisher's exact test between the groups)")))
        }
    }
    for (k in unique(stats[["contrast"]])) {
        s <- stats[contrast == k & !is.na(p_value)]
        n <- nrow(s)
        label <- paste0(model, " (", k, ")")
        qq <- data.table(expected = -log10(ppoints(n)), observed = -log10(sort(s[["p_value"]])), corrected = -log10(sort(s[["p_bacon"]])))
        qq <- qq[expected > 2 | seq_len(.N) %% 50 == 0]
        qq <- melt(qq, id.vars = "expected", variable.name = "version", value.name = "value")
        qq[, version := factor(version, levels = c("observed", "corrected"), labels = c("Before bacon", "After bacon"))]
        lambda <- median(qchisq(s[["p_value"]], 1, lower.tail = FALSE), na.rm = TRUE) / qchisq(0.5, 1)
        show_plot(ggplot(qq, aes(expected, value, colour = version)) + geom_abline(linetype = 2, colour = "grey40") + geom_point(size = 0.7) +
                  scale_colour_manual(values = c(`Before bacon` = "#4c72b0", `After bacon` = "#dd8452")) +
                  labs(x = expression("Expected" ~ -log[10](italic(P))), y = expression("Observed" ~ -log[10](italic(P))), colour = NULL,
                       title = paste0(label, ": quantile-quantile plot of the CpG P-values"),
                       subtitle = sprintf("Genomic inflation lambda = %.2f before bacon. The dashed line is the expectation without any association; bacon (van Iterson et al. 2017) corrects the test statistics for bias and inflation.", lambda)),
                  7, 4.5)
        points <- manhattan_points(s, "t")
        if (nrow(points) > 0) {
            ends <- points[, .(end = max(pos)), by = chromosome][order(chromosome)]
            ends[, offset := c(0, head(cumsum(as.numeric(end) + 5e6), -1))]
            m <- merge(points, ends[, .(chromosome, offset)], by = "chromosome")
            m[, x := (pos + offset) / 1e6]
            centres <- m[, .(x = mean(range(x))), by = chromosome]
            show_plot(ggplot(m, aes(x, -log10(p_value), colour = factor(as.integer(chromosome) %% 2))) + geom_point(size = 0.6) +
                      geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(as.numeric(param("p_epigenome_wide"))), linetype = 1, colour = "grey20", linewidth = 0.4) +
                      scale_colour_manual(values = c(`0` = "grey65", `1` = "grey25"), guide = "none") +
                      scale_x_continuous(breaks = centres[["x"]], labels = as.character(centres[["chromosome"]]), expand = expansion(mult = 0.01)) +
                      theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(), axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8)) +
                      labs(x = "Chromosome", y = expression(-log[10](italic(P))), title = paste0(label, ": Manhattan plot"),
                           subtitle = paste0("Each point is a CpG at its genomic position; the line marks P = ", param("p_epigenome_wide"), " (epigenome-wide). CpGs with P >= 0.01 are thinned to every 20th.")),
                      10, 4.2)
            show_plot(directional_genome(points, threshold_lines(s), paste0(label, ": CpGs with higher and lower methylation")), 10, 5.2)
        }
        print(kable(direction_summary(s, "delta_beta"), caption = paste0(label, ": CpGs at FDR < 0.05 with higher and with lower methylation; the binomial test asks whether one direction dominates")))
        show_plot(volcano_plot(s, "delta_beta", "Difference in methylation (beta) per unit of the trait or between the groups", paste0(label, ": volcano plot")), 8, 5.5)
        if (sum(!is.na(s[["fdr"]]) & s[["fdr"]] < 0.05) >= 5) {
            context <- context_enrichment(s, "delta_beta")
            if (nrow(context) > 0) {
                context_figure <- context_plot(context, paste0(label, ": genomic context of the CpGs at FDR < 0.05"))
                if (!is.null(context_figure)) {
                    if (!schematic_shown) {
                        show_plot(context_schematic(), 12, 4.6)
                        schematic_shown <- TRUE
                    }
                    show_plot(context_figure, 9, 6)
                }
                print(kable(context[, .(Annotation = group, Category = category, Hits = query, `Hits in category` = hits_in, `Share of hits` = round(share_hits, 3),
                                        `Share of tested` = round(share_tested, 3), `Odds ratio` = odds_ratio, P = p_value)],
                            caption = paste0(label, ": genomic context of the hits against all tested CpGs (Fisher's exact test)")))
            }
            level <- level_plot(s, "delta_beta", paste0(label, ": methylation level of the CpGs at FDR < 0.05"))
            if (!is.null(level)) show_plot(level, 8, 3.6)
        }
        top_by_direction(s, "t", c(CpG = "cpg_id", Chr = "chr", Position = "pos", Gene = "gene", `Gene feature` = "gene_group", `CpG island` = "cgi_relation",
                                   `Delta beta` = "delta_beta", t = "t", P = "p_value", FDR = "fdr", `P (bacon)` = "p_bacon"), label)
    }
    cells_file <- sub("_stats\\.tsv\\.gz$", "_cells.tsv.gz", file)
    if (file.exists(cells_file) && file.info(cells_file)[["size"]] > 100) {
        cells_stats <- read(cells_file)
        if (nrow(cells_stats) > 0) {
            cat("\n\n### ", model, ": cell types\n\n", sep = "")
            cat("Cell-type-specific association (the CellDMC design of EpiDISH, Zheng et al. 2018): beta values on the six blood cell lineages, the trait times each lineage and the other covariates of the model. Each interaction tests whether the trait changes methylation within one lineage; the estimate is the change in beta within that lineage per unit of the trait (or between the groups). FDR within each lineage. Lineages with a median fraction below 5% or a genomic lambda above 1.3 are marked unreliable and get no plots or tables: with small fractions the interaction estimate is unstable and can give thousands of false hits. An estimate can only be as good as the cell fractions.\n\n")
            counts <- cells_stats[, .(`Hits (FDR < 0.05)` = sum(fdr < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE), Higher = sum(fdr < 0.05 & estimate > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
                                      Lower = sum(fdr < 0.05 & estimate < 0, na.rm = TRUE),
                                      Lambda = round(median(qchisq(p_value, 1, lower.tail = FALSE), na.rm = TRUE) / qchisq(0.5, 1), 3),
                                      `Top CpG` = cpg_id[which.min(p_value)], `Top P` = min(p_value, na.rm = TRUE),
                                      Status = if ("lineage_status" %in% names(cells_stats)) lineage_status[1] else "ok"), by = .(Lineage = cell)]
            print(kable(counts, caption = paste0(model, ": cell-type-specific hits per lineage")))
            for (lineage in unique(cells_stats[["cell"]])) {
                part <- cells_stats[cell == lineage]
                if ("lineage_status" %in% names(part) && part[["lineage_status"]][1] != "ok") next
                points <- manhattan_points(part, "estimate")
                if (nrow(points) > 0) {
                    show_plot(directional_genome(points, threshold_lines(part), paste0(model, ", ", lineage, " lineage: CpGs with higher and lower methylation within the lineage")),
                              10, 5.2, description = paste0("Cell-type-specific association (CellDMC design); FDR within the ", lineage, " lineage."))
                }
                top_by_direction(part, "estimate", c(CpG = "cpg_id", Chr = "chr", Position = "pos", Gene = "gene", Estimate = "estimate", SE = "se",
                                                     P = "p_value", FDR = "fdr"), paste0(model, ", ", lineage, " lineage"))
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```{r dmr, results = "asis", eval = has("^dmr_.*_consensus\\.tsv$")}
heading("Differentially methylated regions")
for (file in find("^dmr_.*_consensus\\.tsv$")) {
    model <- model_of(file, "dmr_", "_consensus\\.tsv")
    summary_file <- sub("_consensus\\.tsv$", "_summary.json", file)
    if (file.exists(summary_file)) {
        s <- fromJSON(summary_file, simplifyVector = FALSE)
        cat("\n\n**", model, "**: ", s[["status"]], "\n\n", sep = "")
        if (length(s[["contrasts"]]) > 0) {
            counts <- rbindlist(lapply(names(s[["contrasts"]]), function(k) {
                x <- s[["contrasts"]][[k]]
                data.table(Contrast = k, `CpGs tested` = x[["cpgs"]], `CpGs at FDR < 0.05` = x[["cpgs_fdr"]], DMRcate = x[["dmrcate"]], dmrff = x[["dmrff"]],
                           `Found by both` = x[["consensus"]], Note = if (is.null(x[["note"]])) "" else x[["note"]])
            }))
            print(kable(counts, caption = paste0(model, ": regions per method")))
        }
    }
    if (file.info(file)[["size"]] == 0) next
    regions <- read(file)
    if (nrow(regions) == 0) next
    regions[, genes := ifelse(nchar(genes) > 40, paste0(substr(genes, 1, 37), "..."), genes)]
    print(kable(head(regions[order(dmrff_p_adjusted), .(Contrast = contrast, Chr = chr, Start = start, End = end, `DMRcate mean difference` = signif(dmrcate_meandiff, 3),
                                                       `DMRcate FDR` = signif(dmrcate_min_smoothed_fdr, 3), `dmrff estimate` = signif(dmrff_estimate, 3),
                                                       `dmrff P (adjusted)` = signif(dmrff_p_adjusted, 3), Genes = genes)], 20),
                caption = paste0(model, ": consensus regions of DMRcate and dmrff, by dmrff P")))
}
```

```{r enrichment, results = "asis", fig.width = 12, fig.height = 10, eval = has("^enrichment_.*\\.tsv$")}
heading("Gene set enrichment")
for (file in setdiff(find("^enrichment_.*\\.tsv$"), find("_summary"))) {
    model <- model_of(file, "enrichment_", "\\.tsv")
    table <- read(file)
    if (nrow(table) == 0) next
    top <- table[order(p_value), head(.SD, 12), by = .(collection, contrast)]
    top[, label := substr(ifelse(is.na(term) | term == "", set, term), 1, 60)]
    top[, key := paste(collection, contrast, label, sep = "__")]
    top[, key := factor(key, levels = rev(unique(key)))]
    show_plot(ggplot(top, aes(-log10(fdr), key, size = de, colour = fdr < 0.05)) + geom_point() +
        scale_y_discrete(labels = function(x) sub("^.*__", "", x)) +
        scale_colour_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "#c44e52", `FALSE` = "grey60"), labels = c(`TRUE` = "FDR < 0.05", `FALSE` = "FDR >= 0.05")) +
        facet_wrap(~ paste(collection, contrast, sep = ": "), scales = "free_y", ncol = 2) + theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7)) +
        labs(x = "-log10 FDR", y = NULL, size = "Genes with a hit", colour = "Significance", title = paste0(model, ": the 12 gene sets with the smallest P per collection"), subtitle = "missMethyl gometh and gsameth, corrected for the number of CpGs per gene; one panel per collection and contrast."))
    for (coll in unique(table[["collection"]])) {
        part <- table[table[["collection"]] == coll]
        top <- head(part[order(p_value)], 10)
        print(kable(top[, .(Contrast = contrast, Set = set, Term = term, Genes = n, Hits = round(de, 1), P = signif(p_value, 3), FDR = signif(fdr, 3))],
                    caption = paste0(model, ": ", coll, ", top 10")))
    }
}
```

```{r kycg, results = "asis", fig.width = 12, fig.height = 8, eval = has("^kycg_.*\\.tsv$")}
heading("Genomic context enrichment")
cat("KnowYourCG: are the significant CpGs (all, and those with higher or lower methylation) over-represented in chromatin states, transcription factor binding sites, histone marks and other genomic features, against all tested CpGs? Fisher's exact test; log2 odds ratio; FDR within each knowledgebase.\n\n")
for (file in setdiff(find("^kycg_.*\\.tsv$"), find("_summary"))) {
    model <- model_of(file, "kycg_", "\\.tsv")
    table <- read(file)
    if (nrow(table) == 0) next
    top <- table[log2_or > 0][order(p_value), head(.SD, 8), by = .(contrast, query)]
    if (nrow(top) == 0) next
    top[, key := factor(paste(contrast, query, database, set, sep = "__"), levels = rev(unique(paste(contrast, query, database, set, sep = "__"))))]
    top[, shown := pmin(log2_or, 8)]
    show_plot(ggplot(top, aes(shown, key, size = overlap, colour = -log10(pmax(fdr, 1e-300)))) + geom_point() +
        scale_y_discrete(labels = function(x) sub("^[^_]*__[^_]*__", "", x)) +
        scale_colour_gradient(low = "grey60", high = "#c44e52") +
        facet_wrap(~ paste(contrast, query, sep = ": "), scales = "free_y", ncol = 3) + theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7)) +
        labs(x = "log2 odds ratio (capped at 8)", y = NULL, size = "Overlap", colour = "-log10 FDR",
             title = paste0(model, ": the 8 most enriched sets per query")))
    print(kable(head(table[fdr < 0.05 & log2_or > 0][order(p_value), .(Contrast = contrast, Query = query, Database = database, Set = set,
                                                                     `Log2 OR` = round(log2_or, 2), Overlap = overlap, FDR = signif(fdr, 3))], 15),
                caption = paste0(model, ": enriched sets at FDR < 0.05")))
}
```

```{r methods, results = "asis", eval = has("^methods_description_mqc\\.yaml$")}
text <- readLines(find("^methods_description_mqc\\.yaml$"))
start <- grep("^data: \\|", text)
if (length(start) == 1) cat(sub("^  ", "", text[(start + 1):length(text)]), sep = "\n")
```

```{r versions, eval = has("software_mqc_versions\\.yml$")}
lines <- readLines(find("software_mqc_versions\\.yml$")[1])
current <- NA_character_
versions <- list()
for (line in lines) {
    if (grepl("^[^ ].*:$", line)) current <- sub(":$", "", line)
    else if (grepl("^ +[^:]+: ", line)) versions[[length(versions) + 1]] <- data.table(Process = current, Tool = trimws(sub(":.*", "", line)), Version = trimws(sub("^[^:]+: ", "", line)))
}
kable(unique(rbindlist(versions)[, .(Tool, Version)])[order(Tool)], caption = "Software versions")
```

# Limitations

- Region-level P-values (DMRcate, dmrff) are known to be optimistic; regions found by both methods are the more reliable result.
- Clocks and scores were trained on 450K or EPIC v1 data; CpGs that EPIC v2 does not measure take reference means (clocks) or are left out of the sum (scores), as reported in the coverage tables.
- Cell composition is estimated from a blood reference and is only meaningful for blood samples.
- KEGG enrichment needs network access at run time; when unavailable it is reported as not run.
